description: Hand-maintained register of the synthetic AcroForm reference fixture that proves the export flattening (issue #344 part B; FR-069; contracts/export-plan.md §5 step 2a/3). Deliberately NOT part of catalog.json: that catalogue is generated byte-checked by tools/corpus/synthetic/generate.dart and pinned per entry by test/synthetic_fixtures_test.dart, so a python-generated fixture is registered here (checked by test/acroform_fixture_catalog_test.dart) instead of breaking those invariants.

rights.legalBasis: synthetic; project-generated fictional content, no third-party work.
rights.notes: The form text, the field name, and the field value are fictional. The PDF uses base-14 Helvetica and embeds no font outline, no scan, and no real authority form. It carries the visible marker 'Synthetische Testdaten, keine personenbezogenen Daten.'

generator.notes: Hand-written PDF structure (no qpdf/reportlab available). Fixed object order, fixed document id, fixed content and xref offsets; no clock, locale, randomness, or network input. --check regenerates in memory and fails on any byte drift.

delivery.androidRelease: never packaged: not a pubspec asset and web/ is not part of an Android build
delivery.androidTestDelivery: tools/android/t334_drive_export.sh pushes the canonical asset to /data/local/tmp/t334-fixtures and pins its sha256

fixtures.title: AcroForm-Referenz (ein Textfeld, sichtbarer Feldwert)
fixtures.description: One-page fictional form with exactly one AcroForm text field (/FT /Tx), one widget annotation, and a normal appearance whose visible content is the field value. The page content carries only the title, the field label, and the footer — the value exists only in the widget appearance, so a flattening that dropped appearances would lose it.

provenance.source: Generated by tools/corpus/synthetic/make_acroform_fixture.py (fictional reference form with one AcroForm text field).
provenance.notes: Project-generated content only. Any change requires a new catalog version; regeneration is byte-checked by the generator's --check.

synthetic.notes: Deterministic layout source; the field rectangle and the ground truth are declared in the generator.

groundTruth.notes: Exactly one interactive text field. The rectangle is display space (origin top-left, y downwards, unit PDF point); the generator's PDF rect is [56 690 356 708] on a 842 pt page.
